points.en: Phase spans Pleistocene epoch (~2 MYA to 10,000 BCE); hunter-gatherer economy.
points.hi: Phase spans प्लीस्टोसीन epoch (~2 MYA to 10,000 BCE); hunter-gatherer economy.

points.en: Lower Paleolithic: Handaxe-cleaver tradition (Acheulean); Soan & Madrasi cultures; Homo erectus.
points.hi: Lower पुरापाषाण काल: हस्त कुठार-क्लीवर tradition (Acheulean); Soan & Madrasi cultures; Homo erectus.

points.en: Middle Paleolithic: Flake industry (scrapers, borers); Levallois technique; Neanderthal association.
points.hi: Middle पुरापाषाण काल: Flake industry (scrapers, बेधनी); Levallois technique; Neanderthal association.

points.en: Upper Paleolithic: Blade-burin industry; modern Homo sapiens; emergence of art (Bhimbetka).
points.hi: Upper पुरापाषाण काल: फलक-ब्यूरिन industry; modern Homo sapiens; emergence of art (Bhimbetka).

points.en: Key Sites: Soan Valley (Pakistan), Hunsgi (Karnataka), Bhimbetka (MP), Didwana (Rajasthan), Kurnool (AP).
points.hi: Key Sites: Soan Valley (Pakistan), Hunsgi (Karnataka), Bhimbetka (MP), Didwana (Rajasthan), Kurnool (AP).

points.en: Archaeological Evidence: Unpolished stone tools, animal fossils, cave paintings, ostrich eggshells.
points.hi: Archaeological Evidence: Unpolished stone tools, animal fossils, cave paintings, ostrich eggshells.

points.en: Dating Techniques: Radiocarbon dating, Potassium-Argon dating, Stratigraphy, Thermoluminescence.
points.hi: Dating Techniques: Radiocarbon dating, Potassium-Argon dating, Stratigraphy, Thermoluminescence.

misconception.en: Paleolithic humans practiced agriculture and pottery.
misconception.hi: पुरापाषाण काल humans practiced agriculture and pottery.

correction.en: Paleolithic humans were strictly nomadic hunter-gatherers; agriculture and pottery belong to the Neolithic period.
correction.hi: पुरापाषाण काल humans were strictly nomadic hunter-gatherers; agriculture and pottery belong to the नवपाषाण काल period.

misconception.en: Microliths are characteristic of the Lower Paleolithic.
misconception.hi: Microliths are characteristic of the Lower पुरापाषाण काल.

correction.en: Microliths are tiny stone tools diagnostic of the later Mesolithic period, not Paleolithic.
correction.hi: Microliths are tiny stone tools diagnostic of the later मध्यपाषाण काल period, not पुरापाषाण काल.

fiveFacts.en: Paleolithic culture covers 99% of human technological history.
fiveFacts.hi: पुरापाषाण काल culture covers 99% of human technological history.

fiveFacts.en: Soan Valley is the type-site for Lower Paleolithic industries in the Indian subcontinent.
fiveFacts.hi: Soan Valley is the type-site for Lower पुरापाषाण काल industries in the Indian subcontinent.

fiveFacts.en: Fire usage is securely evidenced from Upper Paleolithic and late Middle Paleolithic contexts.
fiveFacts.hi: Fire usage is securely evidenced from Upper पुरापाषाण काल and late Middle पुरापाषाण काल contexts.

fiveFacts.en: Hunsgi in Karnataka is a major Acheulean quarry-cum-workshop site.
fiveFacts.hi: Hunsgi in Karnataka is a major Acheulean quarry-cum-workshop site.

fiveFacts.en: No human skeletal remains of the Paleolithic have been found in clear archaeological context except partial finds like Hathnora.
fiveFacts.hi: No human skeletal remains of the पुरापाषाण काल have been found in clear archaeological context except partial finds like Hathnora.

threeTraps.en: Assuming metal tools existed in the Old Stone Age.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming metal tools existed in the Old Stone Age.

threeTraps.en: Confusing flake industries (Middle Paleolithic) with blade industries (Upper Paleolithic).
threeTraps.hi: फ्लाक उद्योगों (मध्य पुरापाषाण काल) को फलक उद्योगों (उच्च पुरापाषाण काल) के साथ भ्रमित करना।

threeTraps.en: Attributing permanent settlements and animal domestication to Paleolithic humans.
threeTraps.hi: पुरापाषाण काल के इंसानों को स्थायी बस्तियों और पशु पालन का श्रेय देना।
